items.title: Marty Sheller interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 9, 2022
items.q: The name 'Monk' appears only as the interviewer's name (Monk Rowe). The interviewee addresses him as 'Monk' but there is no mention of Thelonious Monk or any personal relationship with him.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive, and boy am I pleased to have Marty Sheller with me today. Mr. Sheller, welcome, and congratulations on your career.
It’s been a long and fruitful one, and I can see behind you at the keyboard and music placed in various spots, that you’re still at it?
